component.name: Nazzil
نزّل
component.summary: Save video, photos and audio from your favourite apps
احفظ الفيديو والصور والصوت من تطبيقاتك المفضلة

description.p: Paste a link from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Reddit, X or Pinterest, pick the quality, and Nazzil saves the file to your Downloads folder.
